addr: #591 14th Main, 591, 15th Cross Rd, near Samarthan Trust, Sector 4, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t:
Great place for gifts and home decor!
Daarva Home Decor has a lovely collection of unique gift items and stylish home decor. Perfect for birthday, anniversary, and housewarming gifts. Quality …
Went in with pretty high expectations after reading all the reviews about custom items and variety, but honestly, it was a big miss. …

The shop has a good range of gifts collections from photo frames to portraits, idols, decorative items, mugs and key chains etc. the shopkeeper was friendly and good enough to suggest me what to pick when I didn’t have an idea what to purchase for the newly wed.  +rep
